cases.source: class C{constructor(a:i32[]){a.length=0;}} export function read(a:i32[],i:u32):i32{const s:ReadSpan<i32>=readSpan(a,0,1);new C(a);return s[i];}

cases.name: implicit-constructor-forward-active-view
cases.source: class C{constructor(a:i32[]){a.length=0;}} class D extends C{} export function read(a:i32[],i:u32):i32{const s:ReadSpan<i32>=readSpan(a,0,1);new D(a);return s[i];}
